rules.provenance: Rules summary is a documented snapshot of C# constants. Simulation executes linked game source; sourceHash identifies that version.
rules.power: Enabled completed consumers draw power even while idle. Proportional brownout after Core and connected last-generator carbon miners.
rules.construction: Ordinary construction uses drones, without grid power. Bay phases use drones and power.
